name: 在聊天里审批
description: agent 等你审批或回答问题、你又不在电脑前时，把它发到你最近私信 bot 的那个聊天（Slack、飞书……任何发 dm 事件的插件），你在那边回一个数字，agent 接着跑。

settings.title: 多久没处理才发
settings.description: 在电脑前的话，通常一会儿就点掉了；过了这么久还在等，才发到聊天里。0 = 马上发。

settings.title: 发到聊天里
settings.description: 关掉就不发（已经发出去的还能回）。

en.name: Approve from chat
en.description: When an agent waits for your approval or an answer and you're away, sends it to the chat you last messaged your bot from (Slack, Feishu… any add-on that emits dm events); reply with a number there and the agent goes on.

delay.title: Send after
delay.description: At the computer you usually handle it within moments; only what still waits after this long goes to the chat. 0 = at once.

on.title: Send to chat
on.description: Off: nothing new is sent (what was sent can still be answered).
